name: Glare Hover
description: A shell that sends a diagonal band of light across its content: it sweeps on hover, moves with the cursor, repeats in a loop, or arrives on click — with three light profiles and a rim that glints too.
interactionNotes: With `mode: hover`, the pointer entering triggers a sweep in the entry direction and leaving sweeps it back (with `playOnce` only once). With `follow` the band stays under the cursor with a spring. With `loop` it sweeps every `interval` seconds, and with `click` on click. Keyboard focus also sweeps.

props.name: children
props.description: The card's content — usually a full-bleed image; the light sits on it with a blend mode.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the shell; any CSS value (such as `'300px'`).

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the shell; any CSS value.

props.name: background
props.description: Background of the shell beneath the content.

props.name: borderRadius
props.description: Corner roundness of the shell, the light, and the glowing rim.

props.name: borderColor
props.description: Color of the shell's one-pixel border.

props.name: glareColor
props.description: Color of the light band and the glowing rim.

props.name: glareOpacity
props.description: Intensity of the light band; the glowing rim takes 1.8 times this value.

props.name: glareAngle
props.description: Angle of the light band in degrees; the sweep direction comes from it.

props.name: glareSize
props.description: Width of the light band as a percentage of the frame's diagonal.

props.name: softness
props.description: Softness of the band's edges in the chosen profile (0 sharp to 1 open).

props.name: variant
props.description: Light profile: a single line, a close pair of lines, or a broad sheen.

props.name: blendMode
props.description: How the light blends with the content; `screen` glows on a dark image.

props.name: rimGlint
props.description: Whether the frame's edge glints along with the band.

props.name: mode
props.description: What sets the band in motion — hover, following the cursor, a timed loop, or click.

props.name: transitionDuration
props.description: Duration of one full sweep in milliseconds; shorter sweeps scale to the shorter distance.

props.name: interval
props.description: Gap between sweeps in `mode: loop`, in seconds (minimum 0.5).

props.name: playOnce
props.description: In `mode: hover`, sweep only on entry and not on exit.

props.name: intro
props.description: As soon as 40% of the frame is visible, do one welcome sweep (once per mount).

props.name: sweepLoop
props.description: Repeat the light sweep endlessly; for a bento card preview.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class on the root.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline style on the root; it merges with the card's own style.

tips: No dependencies: the light profile is built from 33 `color-mix` stops and the rAF loop is awake only while moving.
For product cards, `mode: follow` with high `softness` feels like polished glass; for badges and small cards, `loop` with a long `interval` is calmer.
On a dark image `blendMode: screen` glows; on light content try `overlay` or `soft-light`.
Under `prefers-reduced-motion` the sweeps are off entirely; keyboard focus still gives feedback.
